limitations: Prior residual coordinates are posthoc failures in one coded scene, two correlated frames; lattice is an exploratory inventory, not a new independent scene/holdout
Previously validated evaluated Blender triangles are reused; no new Blender RGB capture or direct fresh Blender ray trace on new UV
Centre-ray point correspondence does not reconstruct bilinear footprint, cubemap or Eevee antialias/filter kernels
UV/status and metric are separate repeat renders on identical static inputs and native source fingerprint, not jointly captured same-render payloads
New matched labels do not replace the two failed historical pairings or imply full-frame cross-backend equivalence
Natural-object, independent nonuniform wrong-point paired controls and exposure/filter ablations remain required; no rejection threshold or Aurora/overhead claim
counterexample_scope: Posthoc illustrations of centre correspondence and raw RGB; no final-image quality gate or chosen threshold.
